title: Electrostatic model minimization and output
action: Construct the energy functions U_p(P) and U_s(P) and the tetragonality functions c_p/a(P) and c_s/a(P) using the provided Landau coefficients. Build the total energy per unit cell area E(P_p^0, P_s^0) = n_p*U_p(P_p^0) + n_s*U_s(P_s^0) + E_elec(P_p^0, P_s^0) with the electrostatic term from the model. For n_s=3 and each n_p in {1,2,3,4,5,6,7}, minimize E with respect to P_p^0 and P_s^0 to find equilibrium values. From the equilibrium polarizations compute the tetragonality ratios c_p/a and c_s/a using the provided c/a expansion. Write all results to a CSV file.
description: CSV containing equilibrium polarizations and tetragonalities for PbTiO3/SrTiO3 superlattices with n_s=3 and varying n_p.
output_schema: Columns: n_p (integer), P_p0 (float, C/m^2), P_s0 (float, C/m^2), tetragonality_Pb (float, dimensionless), tetragonality_Sr (float, dimensionless). One row per n_p from 1 to 7.
